chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 501: Li Huowang's Blood Oath with Zhuge Yuan
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang’s therapy session backfires perfectly, leading to a shocking revelation. He bids farewell to Zhuge Yuan with a bloody, sacred oath. Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 501.
og_description: Li Huowang uses logic to “prove” both worlds are real, then swears a blood oath to resurrect his friend. The madness is just beginning.
twitter_title: He used therapy to get more crazy.
twitter_description: The doctor tried to cure him. He accidentally created a new religion. Li Huowang proves both worlds are real and makes a blood oath to save his friend.

lore_anchors.definition: In Daoist internal alchemy, it's the primordial, pre-universe energy. Li Huowang using it to justify his reality-hopping is peak Li Huowang logic.
A sacred, ritualized bond of brotherhood stronger than blood. The oath to die on the same day is taken very seriously in Chinese culture and comes with heavy karmic weight.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did Li Huowang just prove his schizophrenia is correct?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. He used the doctor’s logic as raw material to build a new, more elaborate delusion that incorporates both worlds as equally real. He “won” the argument by changing the game.
Yes. The faceless, eyeless one is still present, mocking the sacred swearing-in ceremony. It serves as a constant reminder that their lies are woven into the fabric of this reality.
